kpis.lab: Billed euro per vehicle, this period iBilled euro per vehicleEUR 5,769,755 billed in CY2025 = January to December 2025 over 163,199 vehicles in service (that period's own count).Last period: EUR 5,823,331 over 160,125 vehicles.This is the measure that does not move just because the fleet moved.

Net move per vehicle iThe change in euro per vehicle, splitFleet -EUR 0.69: what the fleet change alone took away or handed over.Price EUR 0.67 on the units actually sold.Volume -EUR 0.38 at last period's price.Mix -EUR 0.62: a different basket, at last period's prices.The four add up to the move in euro per vehicle.
kpis.sub: fleet -0.69 | price +0.67 | volume -0.38 | mix -0.62 (rounded to the cent; a cent out in total)

kpis.lab: Fleet denominator iThe denominator163,199 vehicles for CY2025 = January to December 2025.Basis: estimated.UTI CV rows run about 25% LOW in every year against the Israeli ministry's own registrations, so a per-truck figure on this denominator is flattered. Open issue UIO-FCAST.
